name: Should I change real estate agents if my listing expires?

mainEntity.name: Should I change real estate agents if my listing expires?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deciding whether to change agents after an expired listing is a significant decision factor that depends on various factors. Consider your agent's communication, marketing strategy, negotiation skills, and their understanding of your local market, such as Key Biscayne or Coral Gables. If you feel there was a lack of effort, poor communication, or an unrealistic pricing strategy, seeking a new agent might be beneficial. However, if your agent was diligent but market conditions were challenging, reassessing strategy with them might be more effective.
acceptedAnswer.description: Evaluate your current agent's performance and marketing strategy; changing agents might be beneficial if you identify significant shortcomings.
